lines.say: A stem cell is an unspecialised cell with two special properties.
Self-renewal. It divides by mitosis to make more stem cells.

draw.alt: A stem cell divides: one daughter stays a stem cell, the other differentiates

lines.say: Differentiation. It develops into a specialised cell type.

draw.alt: A stem cell divides: one daughter stays a stem cell, the other becomes a red blood cell

lines.say: Like a footy academy. Keep some players back, promote the rest.
Almost every cell in your body has the same DNA.
Cells become different because they express, or switch on, different genes.
Same cookbook, different recipes. Signals from nearby cells help decide.
Fully differentiated cells usually can't change type, and many stop dividing.
Potency is how many cell types a stem cell can become.

draw.alt: Staircase down from totipotent to pluripotent, multipotent and unipotent

lines.say: Totipotent: every cell type, including the placenta. The zygote is totipotent.
Pluripotent: any body cell, but not the placenta. The inner cell mass of a blastocyst.
Multipotent: several types in one family, like blood stem cells in bone marrow.
Unipotent: just one cell type, like some skin stem cells.
Embryonic stem cells come from a blastocyst. They're pluripotent.
But collecting them destroys the embryo, and donor cells may be rejected.
Adult stem cells come from tissues like bone marrow. The patient's own cells, so no rejection.
But they're usually multipotent or unipotent, and rare.
iPS cells are ordinary skin cells, reprogrammed back to pluripotent. Rewinding the clock.
No embryo needed and they match the patient. Risks: genetic changes and tumours.
Bone marrow transplants already treat leukaemia.
Skin grown from a patient's own stem cells treats severe burns.
Treatments for spinal injury, diabetes and Parkinson's are mostly still in trials.
Ethics: the status of the embryo, consent, safety, and cost.
In Australia, human embryo research needs a licence.
Only totipotent cells can make the placenta and a whole organism.
Differentiated cells have the same DNA. They express different genes.
Adult stem cells are in children too. Adult just means not embryonic.
iPS cells come from body cells, not embryos.
Self-renewal and differentiation.
Toti, pluri, multi, uni. Potency only rolls downhill.
